en: Attendant
Leaving the Safari Zone already? You still have time left. Are you sure?
Very well. Please hand back your Safari Balls. We hope to see you again!
Then off you go. Good luck out there!
Attendant
Did you catch your fair share? Come again any time!
Attendant
Welcome to the Safari Zone!
For just $500, you can catch all the Pokémon you like! Would you like to play the Safari Game?
That'll be $500, thank you. Here you are: we use only these special balls in the zone.
{player} received 30 Safari Balls!
We'll call you over the speakers when your game is up. Enjoy yourself!
I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.
Very well. Please come again!
Attendant
Walk up to the door behind me, and I'll ask whether you'd like to play the Safari Game.
Attendant
The Safari Zone has four parts, each with its own Pokémon. Would you like to hear how the Safari Game works?
You go in with 30 Safari Balls. They're the only balls you may throw inside.
You can't battle the Pokémon you meet, but you can throw things to calm them or rile them up. Try it and see!
The game is over when you've walked 600 steps, or when your last ball is thrown.
Then enjoy the Safari Zone!
